phrases.latin: nudius tertius dedī ad tē epistulam longiōrem
phrases.english: the day before yesterday I sent you a longer letter

phrases.latin: Nudius tertius nīnxit; hodiē sōl lūcet.
phrases.english: The day before yesterday it snowed; today the sun is shining.
